title: Associate Product Manager Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen product expertise, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for senior-level interviews. Focuses on advanced tactics, leadership, and polished communication.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Refresh core product fundamentals and communication basics.

milestones.title: Customer discovery fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can conduct structured user interviews and synthesize insights.

tasks.title: Read product discovery guide on Mind the Product
tasks.description: Study the article’s framework for hypothesis-driven interviews.

tasks.title: Watch interview techniques video on YouTube
tasks.description: Observe real interview examples and note key questioning patterns.

tasks.title: Create interview script for a target persona
tasks.description: Draft 5 open-ended questions aligned with a hypothesis.

tasks.title: Conduct a 30-minute mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Practice asking questions and recording responses.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in a one-page insight sheet
tasks.description: Highlight top pain points and opportunity statements.

milestones.title: Writing clear specifications
milestones.outcome: Can produce concise product requirement documents (PRDs).

tasks.title: Read PRD template on Aha! blog
tasks.description: Understand sections, tone, and level of detail expected.

tasks.title: Study a public PRD on GitHub
tasks.description: Identify how problem, goals, and acceptance criteria are expressed.

tasks.title: Draft a PRD for a simple feature (e.g., dark mode)
tasks.description: Include problem statement, user flow, and success metrics.

tasks.title: Peer-review the draft with a colleague
tasks.description: Gather feedback on clarity and completeness.

tasks.title: Revise PRD based on feedback
tasks.description: Incorporate suggestions and polish language.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop prioritisation, metrics, and roadmapping capabilities.

milestones.title: Prioritisation frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can apply RICE or Kano to rank feature ideas objectively.

tasks.title: Read RICE scoring article on Intercom
tasks.description: Learn inputs, calculation, and interpretation.

tasks.title: Watch Kano model tutorial on Coursera (audit mode)
tasks.description: Understand how to map satisfaction vs. functionality.

tasks.title: Score three feature ideas using RICE
tasks.description: Create a spreadsheet with inputs and total scores.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock prioritisation workshop with a friend
tasks.description: Present scores and discuss trade-offs.

tasks.title: Write a brief justification for the top-ranked idea
tasks.description: Explain why it wins based on data and strategy.

milestones.title: Metrics and analytics basics
milestones.outcome: Can define, track, and interpret key product metrics.

tasks.title: Read Google Analytics for product on analytics Academy
tasks.description: Focus on event tracking and goal funnels.

tasks.title: Study Amplitude’s guide to North Star metrics
tasks.description: Identify how to choose a guiding metric.

tasks.title: Create a metrics plan for a feature launch
tasks.description: List activation, retention, and revenue KPIs with targets.

tasks.title: Set up a dummy dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Visualize sample data for the chosen KPIs.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric alignment with business goals
tasks.description: Write a short note linking each KPI to strategic outcomes.

milestones.title: Roadmapping and stakeholder communication
milestones.outcome: Can design a product roadmap and convey it to cross-functional teams.

tasks.title: Read product roadmap guide on ProductPlan blog
tasks.description: Learn timeline structures and level of detail.

tasks.title: Watch stakeholder communication video on LinkedIn learning (free trial)
tasks.description: Observe techniques for aligning expectations.

tasks.title: Sketch a 6-month roadmap for a hypothetical product line
tasks.description: Include themes, epics, and release windows.

tasks.title: Present the roadmap to a peer and gather feedback
tasks.description: Practice clear storytelling and answering questions.

tasks.title: Update roadmap based on feedback and write a communication email
tasks.description: Summarize changes and next steps for stakeholders.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate product thinking.

milestones.title: Product teardown project
milestones.outcome: Can analyze an existing product and present strengths, weaknesses, and improvement ideas.

tasks.title: Select a popular app and download its latest version
tasks.description: Choose something you use regularly for relevance.

tasks.title: Read teardown framework on Medium (free article)
tasks.description: Understand criteria such as onboarding, value proposition, and monetization.

tasks.title: Write a 2-page teardown report
tasks.description: Cover user flow, pain points, and three concrete improvement suggestions.

tasks.title: Create a slide deck summarizing the teardown
tasks.description: Design 5 slides with visuals and key takeaways.

tasks.title: Share the deck on LinkedIn and collect comments
tasks.description: Engage the community for feedback and visibility.

milestones.title: PRD for a new feature
milestones.outcome: Can produce a full product requirement document ready for engineering handoff.

tasks.title: Identify a gap in your current product’s experience
tasks.description: Observe usage data or user complaints to pick a feature.

tasks.title: Research similar features in competitor apps
tasks.description: Note functionality, UX, and metrics used.

tasks.title: Draft a complete PRD using the template from phase 1
tasks.description: Include problem, goals, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Run a mock review session with a teammate
tasks.description: Present the PRD and answer clarification questions.

tasks.title: Incorporate feedback and finalize the PRD
tasks.description: Polish language, add diagrams, and ensure completeness.

milestones.title: Metrics plan for a launch
milestones.outcome: Can design a data-driven measurement plan for a product release.

tasks.title: Choose a recent product launch case study (e.g., Slack connect)
tasks.description: Read the launch overview on the company blog.

tasks.title: Extract the key success metrics used in the case study
tasks.description: List activation, retention, and revenue indicators.

tasks.title: Build a metrics plan template in Google Sheets
tasks.description: Define metric, source, target, and owner columns.

tasks.title: Populate the template for your own feature idea
tasks.description: Set realistic targets and measurement cadence.

tasks.title: Write a short executive summary of the plan
tasks.description: Explain why each metric matters for the launch.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership abilities, interview readiness, and stakeholder influence.

milestones.title: Improve stakeholder communication
milestones.outcome: Can influence cross-functional partners and handle difficult conversations.

tasks.title: Read “influence without Authority” article on Harvard business review
tasks.description: Learn techniques for persuasive dialogue.

tasks.title: Watch negotiation role-play on YouTube (product manager scenario)
tasks.description: Observe tactics for win-win outcomes.

tasks.title: Draft a stakeholder briefing for a high-impact decision
tasks.description: Include context, options, and recommendation.

tasks.title: Role-play the briefing with a friend acting as a skeptical stakeholder
tasks.description: Practice answering objections and staying calm.

tasks.title: Reflect on what communication style worked best
tasks.description: Write a brief note on adjustments for future talks.

milestones.title: Leadership and decision-making
milestones.outcome: Can lead product discussions and make data-informed trade-offs.

tasks.title: Read “The Lean Product Playbook” chapter on decision making (free summary)
tasks.description: Understand the iterative decision loop.

tasks.title: Watch a senior PM panel on product strategy (Google I/O archive)
tasks.description: Note how leaders frame choices and justify them.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock sprint planning session with peers
tasks.description: Lead backlog grooming, estimation, and commitment.

tasks.title: Document the decisions made and rationale in a one-page log
tasks.description: Capture data sources, assumptions, and outcomes.

tasks.title: Reflect on decision quality after the sprint
tasks.description: Identify any biases or missing data.

milestones.title: Senior-level interview prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer product case studies and behavioral questions.

tasks.title: Read product interview guide on Exponent (free preview)
tasks.description: Familiarize with common frameworks and expectations.

tasks.title: Watch product case study walkthrough on YouTube (FAANG PM)
tasks.description: Analyze structure and storytelling techniques.

tasks.title: Practice a full case interview with a peer using a random prompt
tasks.description: Time yourself to 30 minutes and record the session.

tasks.title: Write a post-mortem of your performance
tasks.description: Highlight strengths, gaps, and action items.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior PM on LinkedIn for a 15-minute coffee chat
tasks.description: Ask for feedback on your approach and portfolio.
